assignments.name: config
assignments.value:
={{ {
  companyName: $env.COMPANY_NAME || 'Northwind Analytics',
  companyDescription: $env.COMPANY_DESCRIPTION || 'a reporting automation platform for operations teams',
  senderName: $env.SENDER_NAME || 'Maya from Northwind',
  senderEmail: $env.SENDER_EMAIL || 'maya@northwind.test',
  salesReps: ($env.SALES_REPS || 'alex@northwind.test,sam@northwind.test').split(',').map(r => r.trim()).filter(r => r),
  bookingUrl: $env.BOOKING_URL || 'https://cal.com/northwind/intro',
  publicUrl: ($env.PUBLIC_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:5678').replace(/\/+$/, ''),
  llmEnabled: !!$env.LLM_API_KEY,
  llmBaseUrl: ($env.LLM_BASE_URL || 'https://api.openai.com/v1').replace(/\/+$/, ''),
  llmModel: $env.LLM_MODEL || 'gpt-4o-mini',
  followUpUnit: ($env.DEMO_FAST_FOLLOW_UPS || 'true') === 'true' ? '1 minute' : '1 day'
} }}

parameters.query:
select coalesce(json_agg(x order by x.created_at desc), '[]'::json) as leads
  from (
        select l.id, l.full_name, l.email, l.company, l.category, l.score, l.status,
               l.owner_email, l.classified_by, l.summary, l.follow_up_step,
               l.next_follow_up_at, l.last_contacted_at, l.created_at,
               (select count(*) from lead_activities a where a.lead_id = l.id) as activity_count
          from leads l
         order by l.created_at desc
         limit 200
       ) x
